banner.title: authentik
banner.tagline: Runs the identity provider for single sign-on, and the embedded outpost that gates ExtAuth routes at the gateway.

art.about: an identity provider with a database, a secret merge and a gateway gate
art.title: How authentik signs in and gates apps

explainer.title: Identity in Postgres, gates at the gateway

steps.title: Database
steps.text: authentik-db creates the role and database authentik on the shared CloudNativePG cluster before the app starts.
steps.scene: a database cylinder with a key slot

steps.title: Secrets
steps.text: ExternalSecret authentik-secret merges three 1Password items into one Secret, and Reloader restarts the pods when it changes.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: The server and worker run flows and sessions. Sessions live in Postgres, cache sits on Dragonfly, and media goes to a Ceph bucket.
steps.scene: two server racks linked by a data path

steps.title: Gate
steps.text: The embedded outpost answers Envoy ExtAuth checks under /outpost.goauthentik.io, so an outage fails every gated app closed.
steps.scene: a padlock gate in front of an arch

facts.label: own role on the shared cluster
